scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c gray,red "npm run dev -w @fumigadora/server" "npm run dev -w @fumigadora/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fumigadora/web && npm run build -w @fumigadora/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @fumigadora/shared && npm run typecheck -w @fumigadora/server && npm run typecheck -w @fumigadora/web
